controles.affirmation: Provision de remediation 562 M$ fin 2025, +18% sur un an (478 M$ fin 2024, 501 M$ fin 2023)
controles.verbatim_source: Balance at December 31, 2023 $501 ... Balance at December 31, 2024 $478 ... Balance at December 31, 2025 $562

controles.affirmation: Exposition ADDITIONNELLE jugee possible jusqu'a environ 1,1 Md$
controles.verbatim_source: it is reasonably possible that the ultimate cost with respect to these particular matters could range up to approximately $553 million above the accrued obligations amount
controles.correction_proposee: L'exposition additionnelle possible est d'environ 553 M$ AU-DELA des provisions. Le 1,1 Md$ est la somme 562 + 553, soit le cout TOTAL possible, pas l'exposition supplementaire. L'ATT double l'exposition incrementale. Reformuler : "provision de 562 M$, avec jusqu'a ~553 M$ d'exposition additionnelle possible, soit un cout total pouvant atteindre ~1,1 Md$".

controles.affirmation: Litiges chlorpyrifos : dommages neurologiques, exposition professionnelle, riverains, in utero ; provision constituee au 30 juin 2026
controles.verbatim_source: Claimants allege personal injury, including autism, parkinsonism, developmental delays and/or decreased neurologic function, resulting from farm worker exposure and bystander drift and in utero exposure to chlorpyrifos. Certain claimants have also put forth remediation claims due to alleged property contamination from chlorpyrifos. As of June 30, 2026, an accrual has been established for the estimated resolution of certain claims.

controles.verbatim_source: the NJ Statewide Settlement obligates certain settling companies to continue to undertake remediation at the four Historical DuPont sites

controles.affirmation: Tresorerie 2 365 M$ contre 4 521 M$ au 31 decembre 2025, soit -1 156 M$
controles.correction_proposee: Erreur arithmetique : 4 521 - 2 365 = 2 156 M$, pas 1 156 M$. Le pourcentage annonce (-48%) est lui correct.

controles.affirmation: Contribution discretionnaire de 1 140 M$ versee au fonds de pension US au premier semestre 2026, a l'origine de l'essentiel de la consommation de cash
controles.verbatim_source: Pension and OPEB contributions (1,140) (84) ... In April 2026, the company's Board of Directors approved a discretionary contribution to the principal U.S. pension plan of approximately $1.5 billion... An initial contribution of $1,061 million was made in June 2026, and a supplemental contribution of $399 million was made in July 2026
controles.correction_proposee: Deux corrections. (1) 1 140 M$ = total des contributions retraite ET OPEB ; la contribution discretionnaire au plan US versee au S1 est de 1 061 M$, sur un engagement total d'environ 1,5 Md$ (399 M$ supplementaires en juillet 2026). (2) La consommation de cash operationnelle du semestre (-3 345 M$) est dominee par le besoin en fonds de roulement saisonnier (creances -2 416, revenus differes -3 187), pas par la pension. Remplacer "provient largement de" par "est aggravee par".
